readme.summary: This project provides 3D-printable holders for storing 3D printer filament in an IKEA KALLAX shelving unit. Two holders store five reels at the front and five filament refills without spools on a raised row at the back.
readme.hero_alt: AI-generated CAD render: finished filament storage in a KALLAX cell
readme.configuration:
Front: 4 short frames. Rear: 4 tall frames. Rail heights: 37 / 112 mm. Row centres: 187 mm. Nominal cell width: 335 mm.

Illustrated rolls: front diameter 200 x 60 mm wide; rear diameter 200 x 58 mm wide. Five rolls at 62 mm centres occupy 308 mm.
readme.configuration_alt: AI-generated CAD render: two populated cells in a 4 by 4 KALLAX shelving unit
readme.quantity_note: Double for two cells. Print all 32 plastic parts in black.
readme.preparation: Measure the opening. Check the 5 mm hex pockets against the nuts and bolt heads. Cut and deburr four 300 mm M6 rods. Prepare a 10 mm spanner.
readme.assembly_alt: AI-generated CAD render: exploded short holder showing four side frames and two threaded rails

assembly_steps.text: Cut and deburr four 300 mm M6 rods. Seat two M6 nuts in a short frame’s outer recesses. Thread in two rods with their ends flush.
assembly_steps.alt: AI-generated CAD render: fixed-end frame, recessed nuts and two rods

assembly_steps.text: On both rods, fit a 99.67 mm sleeve, second frame, 67.67 mm sleeve, third frame and 99.67 mm sleeve. Face the last sleeve’s hex pocket toward the coupling.
assembly_steps.alt: AI-generated CAD render: three frames and long sleeves on the two rods

assembly_steps.text: Insert each M6 coupling nut into an 18 mm housing. Thread it onto the rod by approximately 6 mm.
assembly_steps.alt: AI-generated CAD render: rod end, M6 coupling nut and printed housing

assembly_steps.text: Face the final frame’s hex recesses outward. Insert the M6 × 25 mm bolts. Add retaining nuts loosely, then slide on the 7 mm hex covers. Thread the bolts into the couplings.
assembly_steps.alt: AI-generated CAD render: coupling, covers, retaining nut, final frame and adjustment bolt

assembly_steps.text: Set the span to the measured opening; nominally 335 mm. Seat the bolt heads in their recesses. Tighten the retaining nuts against the inner frame face, replace the hex covers and clip the 7 mm slotted covers over the exposed thread.
assembly_steps.alt: AI-generated section drawing: recessed bolt head, retaining nut and end covers

assembly_steps.text: Repeat with four tall frames. Place the tall holder at the rear and the short holder at the front. Load strapped rear refills, then front reels.
assembly_steps.alt: AI-generated CAD render: both holders installed and loaded in a KALLAX cell

readme.detail_alt: AI-generated engineering section: one coupling, 7 mm clip, retaining nut in a 7 mm hex cover and recessed bolt head
readme.adjustment:
Per rail: one 18 mm coupling, one M6 x 25 bolt, one retaining M6 nut, one 7 mm hex cover and one 7 mm slotted cover.

To adjust: remove P7; slide P6 aside; loosen H2; release the bolt head from its recess; turn H4. Reseat the head, tighten H2 and refit both covers.
installation_steps: Place the tall holder at the rear and the short holder at the front. Seat all feet on the shelf.
Check width and fastener seating before loading. Do not force the cabinet sides apart.
Load strapped rear refills, then front reels. Check clearance and frame stability.
readme.dimensions:
Nominal rail stack: `4 x 9 + 2 x 99.67 + 67.67 + 18 + 7 + 7 = 335.01 mm`.

M6 x 25 bolt: 7 mm nominal coupling engagement; 5.01 mm tip clearance. Rod engagement: 5.99 mm. Slotted cover length for another opening: `opening - 328.01 mm`; recheck engagement before use.
readme.details: Each holder uses four side frames and two adjustable M6 rails. The short and tall holders are independent. Nominal width: 335 mm. Rail heights: 37 and 112 mm. Print all 32 plastic pieces in black.
readme.details_alt: AI-generated CAD render: assembled printed parts, with hardware, filament and cabinet omitted
readme.parts_alt: AI-generated CAD render: exploded short holder with frames, sleeves and hardware
readme.parts_caption: Short holder shown. The rear holder uses tall frames.
readme.parts_scope: Hardware quantities for one complete cell. Double for two cells.
